definitions.downstream: token-weighted CE and mean KL; expCE = exp(aggregated CE)
definitions.gain: mean_text(log1p(E_before) - log1p(E_after)); positive means lower error
definitions.layer_count: unique (model, layer), not unique numeric layer indices
definitions.physical_head: unique (model, layer, query head); texts are not independent heads

calibration.negative_calibrated_predictions: retained in log space, not clipped

definitions.calibration: OLS affine map of log1p(relative Frobenius error), pooled training variants only
definitions.dependence: Repeated texts, layers, and GQA-sharing heads are dependent; no p-values
definitions.sign_accuracy: exact agreement of signs including zero; gains only
definitions.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks; undefined constants return null
definitions.units: Both MSE fields = squared Frobenius error / reference squared Frobenius norm

limitations: Heads share model weights, layers and inputs; texts and heads are dependent observations.
Descriptive summaries only: no inferential confidence intervals or independence claims.
Prediction points average per-text gains within each physical model/layer/query head.
Actual head errors are relative Frobenius errors against an FP64 attention reference.
Downstream is batch teacher forcing on held-out tokens, not streaming/generation perplexity.
Full-key means and block scales can depend on later tokens in the teacher-forced batch.
